verses.en: And Job answered and said,
verses.pt: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Job made answer and said,

verses.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.pt: Verdadeiramente vós sois o povo; e convosco morrerá a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.en_bbe: No doubt you have knowledge, and wisdom will come to an end with you.

verses.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.pt: Também eu tenho entendimento como vós; e não sou inferior a vós; e quem há que não saiba coisas como essas?
verses.en_web: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
verses.en_bbe: But I have a mind as well as you; I am equal to you: yes, who has not knowledge of such things as these?

verses.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.pt: Eu sou o motivo de riso de meus amigos, eu que invocava a Deus, e ele me respondia; o justo e íntegro serve de riso.
verses.en_web: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
verses.en_bbe: It seems that I am to be as one who is a cause of laughing to his neighbour, one who makes his prayer to God and is answered! the upright man who has done no wrong is to be made sport of!

verses.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.pt: Na opinião de quem está descansado, a desgraça é desprezada, como se estivesse preparada aos que cujos pés escorregam.
verses.en_web: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
verses.en_bbe: In the thought of him who is in comfort there is no respect for one who is in trouble; such is the fate of those whose feet are slipping.

verses.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
verses.pt: As tendas dos ladrões têm descanso, e os que irritam a Deus estão seguros; os que trazem seu deus em suas mãos.
verses.en_web: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their God in their hands.
verses.en_bbe: There is wealth in the tents of those who make destruction, and those by whom God is moved to wrath are safe; even those whose god is their strength.

verses.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.pt: Verdadeiramente pergunta agora aos animais, que eles te ensinarão; e às aves dos céus, que elas te explicarão;
verses.en_web: “But ask the animals, now, and they shall teach you; the birds of the sky, and they shall tell you.
verses.en_bbe: But put now a question to the beasts, and get teaching from them; or to the birds of the heaven, and they will make it clear to you;

verses.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.pt: Ou fala com a terra, que ela te ensinará; até os peixes do mar te contarão.
verses.en_web: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you. The fish of the sea shall declare to you.
verses.en_bbe: Or to the things which go flat on the earth, and they will give you wisdom; and the fishes of the sea will give you news of it.

verses.en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
verses.pt: Quem entre todas estas coisas não entende que a mão do SENHOR faz isto?
verses.en_web: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
verses.en_bbe: Who does not see by all these that the hand of the Lord has done this?

verses.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.pt: Em sua mão está a alma de tudo quanto vive, e o espírito de toda carne humana.
verses.en_web: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
verses.en_bbe: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all flesh of man.

verses.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.pt: Por acaso o ouvido não distingue as palavras, e o paladar prova as comidas?
verses.en_web: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
verses.en_bbe: Are not words tested by the ear, even as food is tasted by the mouth?

verses.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.pt: Nos velhos está o conhecimento, e na longa idade o entendimento.
verses.en_web: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Old men have wisdom, and a long life gives knowledge.

verses.en: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.pt: Com Deus está a sabedoria e a força; o conselho e o entendimento lhe pertencem.
verses.en_web: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
verses.en_bbe: With him there is wisdom and strength; power and knowledge are his.

verses.en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.pt: Eis que o que ele derruba não pode ser reconstruído; e ninguém pode libertar o homem a quem ele aprisiona.
verses.en_web: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, there is no building up of what is pulled down by him; when a man is shut up by him, no one may let him loose.

verses.en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.pt: Eis que, quando ele detém as águas, elas se secam; quando ele as deixa sair, elas transtornam a terra.
verses.en_web: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, he keeps back the waters and they are dry; he sends them out and the earth is overturned.

verses.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.pt: Com ele está a força e a sabedoria; Seu é o que erra, e o que faz errar.
verses.en_web: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.en_bbe: With him are strength and wise designs; he who is guided into error, together with his guide, are in his hands;

verses.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.pt: Ele leva os conselheiros despojados, e faz os juízes enlouquecerem.
verses.en_web: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
verses.en_bbe: He takes away the wisdom of the wise guides, and makes judges foolish;

verses.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.pt: Ele solta a atadura dos reis, e ata um cinto a seus lombos.
verses.en_web: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
verses.en_bbe: He undoes the chains of kings, and puts his band on them;

verses.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.pt: Ele leva os sacerdotes despojados, e transtorna os poderosos.
verses.en_web: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
verses.en_bbe: He makes priests prisoners, overturning those in safe positions;

verses.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.pt: Ele tira a fala daqueles a quem os outros confiam, e tira o juízo dos anciãos.
verses.en_web: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
verses.en_bbe: He makes the words of responsible persons without effect, and takes away the good sense of the old;

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.pt: Ele derrama menosprezo sobre os príncipes, e afrouxa o cinto dos fortes.
verses.en_web: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
verses.en_bbe: He puts shame on chiefs, and takes away the power of the strong;

verses.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.pt: Ele revela as profundezas das trevas, e traz a sombra de morte à luz.
verses.en_web: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
verses.en_bbe: Uncovering deep things out of the dark, and making the deep shade bright;

verses.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.pt: Ele multiplica as nações, e ele as destrói; ele dispersa as nações, e as reúne.
verses.en_web: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
verses.en_bbe: Increasing nations, and sending destruction on them; making wide the lands of peoples, and then giving them up.

verses.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.pt: Ele tira o entendimento dos líderes do povo da terra, e os faz vaguear pelos desertos, sem caminho.
verses.en_web: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.en_bbe: He takes away the wisdom of the rulers of the earth, and sends them wandering in a waste where there is no way.

verses.en: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.pt: Nas trevas andam apalpando, sem terem luz; e os faz cambalear como a bêbados.
verses.en_web: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
verses.en_bbe: They go feeling about in the dark without light, wandering without help like those overcome with wine.
